versions.content: If the UDS service ResponseOnEvent (0x86) is received with the subservice StartResponseOnEvent, then the DSP sub-module shall store the respec- tive configured connectionId of the received RxPduId for all RoeEvents which will be started until the eventWindowTime times out.
